scope.description: Named deep-dossier cohort covering three Canadian underwater-service candidates and one terminally out-of-scope United States accelerator after exhaustive Canada-nexus recovery.

source.title: MAKO Diving and Marine Services
source.publisher: MAKO Diving and Marine Services Inc.
source.locator: Home page, service overview, veteran-ownership statement and emergency-response footer
source.summary: MAKO's official home page presents commercial diving, ROV, sonar, video, marine construction, repair, salvage and 24-hour response services and states that the company is veteran owned and operated.

leads.evidenceLocator: Home page, service overview, veteran-ownership statement and emergency-response footer

duplicateFingerprint.legalName: MAKO Diving and Marine Services Inc.

followUpQuestions: Which Hanwell or Lincoln address should be treated as MAKO's current primary operating location for public mapping?
Which ROV model, depth rating, sonar, camera, manipulator and mobilization configuration is currently available for a specific mission?
Which recent municipal, police or federal engagements were awarded rather than limited to bidding or vendor-partnering activity?
reviewWarnings: The official site labels the public location Hanwell and embeds a Hanwell-area map point, while the 2026 FNWCA directory publishes 158 Garden Grove Road in Lincoln; retain the dated location conflict for review.
The official 100% veteran-owned statement is not an independently verified share registry or beneficial-ownership record.
No public source identifies the ROV make, model, depth rating, payload, sensor configuration or mobilization limits.
Municipal bidder and plan-taker records prove procurement access, not contract award or customer endorsement.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Recovered the exact incorporated name, 2021 distinct-company origin, president and official veteran-ownership statement.
Recovered a concrete ROV service boundary and use conditions, but no public model, depth, payload or sensor specification.
Recovered current COR status and 2026-12-06 expiry for the exact legal entity.
Recovered independent evidence of a September 2023 MAKO ROV survey and October 2023 diving work.
Recovered repeat municipal procurement participation, explicitly not an award.

Final exact-name federal and provincial public-registry recovery produced no public shareholder or beneficial-ownership record; legal identity remained independently triangulated by current COR and association directories.
Final DND, DFO, RCMP and federal-award lane produced no recent award; it recovered only a 2023 vendor-partnering profile for the exact legal entity.

leads.candidateCapabilityName: ROV- and sonar-assisted underwater inspection and search
leads.roleSpecificEvidence: MAKO Diving & Marine Services has a resolved Canadian operating identity, a concrete ROV- and sonar-assisted underwater inspection and search offer, mapped leaf evidence, independent delivery evidence and explicit record-specific warnings for review.

source.title: Manitoba Companies Office Weekly Listing 2025-01-11
source.summary: The provincial filing shows Dominion Divers (2025) Ltd. formed by amalgamation effective 2025-01-01 from Dominion Divers (2003) Ltd., Guyco One Inc., Garth M. Hiebert Company Ltd. and 10178711 Manitoba Ltd.

followUpQuestions: Who are the current beneficial owners and directors of Dominion Divers (2025) Ltd. after the 2025 amalgamation?
Which inspection-class ROV model, depth, sensor, manipulator and mobilization configuration is available for a specific project?
Which current ISO, diving-standard, insurance and bonding credentials apply to the exact requested work scope and contracting entity?
reviewWarnings: Use Dominion Divers (2025) Ltd. as the current legal entity; Dominion Divers (2003) Ltd. is a predecessor amalgamated effective 2025-01-01.

CanadaBuys displays DOMINION DIVERS LTD. without the parenthetical year, but the exact 14 Penner Road address and standardized name connect the award to the current business; Manitoba and CIPO control the legal-name field.
Do not conflate Dominion Divers with the separate published Nova Scotia organization Dominion Diving at dominiondiving.com.
Public sources confirm an inspection-class ROV service but do not publish the ROV make, model, depth, payload or configuration.
Treat ISO, insurance and bonding values on the company site as vendor-attributed unless independently verified.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Recovered the exact current legal entity, file number, effective amalgamation date and all predecessor corporations.
Recovered the current Dominion Divers Marine Contractors business-name registration and exact operating address.
Independently corroborated the title change from the 2003 entity to Dominion Divers (2025) Ltd. and exact address.
Recovered concrete inspection-class ROV, diver-inspection, NDT and infrastructure use cases but no model-level operating envelope.
Recovered a current CAD 866,736.06 federal award at the exact Navin address with delivery through 2027.
Final exact DND and Royal Canadian Navy award search produced no current defence contract for Dominion Divers (2025) Ltd.
Final model/configuration lane confirmed inspection-class ROV and sonar outputs but produced no ROV make, depth, payload or configuration.

leads.roleSpecificEvidence: Dominion Divers has a resolved Canadian operating identity, a concrete ROV and sonar infrastructure inspection offer, mapped leaf evidence, independent delivery evidence and explicit record-specific warnings for review.

source.title: BC Safety Rating Certificate Status for BC Carriers
source.publisher: British Columbia Commercial Vehicle Safety and Enforcement
source.locator: Updated July 14, 2026; Advanced Subsea Services Ltd. Sidney row
source.summary: The provincial bulletin lists the exact legal name in Sidney with certificate status Active, fleet size one and safety rating Satisfactory - Unaudited. It proves current carrier status, not full corporate good standing or diving accreditation.

leads.evidenceLocator: Updated July 14, 2026; Advanced Subsea Services Ltd. Sidney row
followUpQuestions: Who are the current beneficial owners, directors and officers of Advanced Subsea Services Ltd.?
Which Seaeye Falcon, tether-management and work-class ROV assets are currently owned, reserved or available through an agent for the intended project?
Which diving, quality, safety, security and OEM-support credentials are current for the exact proposed work scope?
reviewWarnings: Current beneficial ownership, parent status and officers were not resolved; the 2009 federal no-parent and president record is historical only.
The official technical pages carry a 2018 copyright and require a freshness warning even though current regulatory and buyer records prove the company remains active.
Official language says the company may own or have quick access to inspection ROVs and may source work-class vehicles as an agent; do not present every system as owned inventory.
The 2026 Metro Vancouver figure is vendor expenditure and the NTPC record is bidder participation, not necessarily a new award.
No current CADC membership source was recovered; do not claim current CADC membership.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Recovered the exact official Sidney mailing address and current public operations contact routes.
Recovered the exact legal name and Active Sidney carrier status in a bulletin updated 2026-07-14.
Recovered concrete Falcon, video, sonar, manipulator and owned/accessed/agent fleet boundaries, with a freshness warning.
Recovered a 2024 municipal diving-services award to the exact legal entity for CAD 78,700.
Recovered independent historical delivery details for a large Surrey sewer-pipe inspection project.
Final current DND and Coast Guard procurement search produced no current award for the exact entity; only historical 2010-2013 federal awards were visible.
Final ownership and officer recovery produced only a 2009 no-parent and president record, insufficient for current control; no acquisition was found.

leads.roleSpecificEvidence: Advanced Subsea Services has a resolved Canadian operating identity, a concrete Inspection ROV and subsea survey services offer, mapped leaf evidence, independent delivery evidence and explicit record-specific warnings for review.

source.title: Propellant Labs Global Accelerator
source.locator: Program, country reach, mentor, funding and 2026 footer sections
source.summary: The official site presents a global remote 16-week accelerator across technology, fintech, cleantech and ecommerce, states 25-plus countries and 500-plus founders and publishes a 2026 copyright.

leads.evidenceLocator: Program, country reach, mentor, funding and 2026 footer sections
followUpQuestions: Re-open only if a durable source establishes a Canadian entity, location, staff member, funded program, partner or named participant.
reviewWarnings: Do not infer a Canadian nexus from global remote availability or the official claim of participation across more than 25 countries.
The California entity record is corroborated through a Secretary-of-State-derived registry mirror; the official company terms independently establish the LLC and California-law boundary.
Buko Ventures corroborates a startup-support relationship but does not establish Canada-specific operation or ownership.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Recovered the active global accelerator offer and 2026 lifecycle but no Canadian program, location or participant.
Recovered the active California LLC, Temecula address, filing number and US managers.
Recovered independent accelerator/support corroboration but no Canadian partner or operating nexus.
Searched cohort, founder and city variants for Canada, Toronto, Vancouver and Montreal; no durable named Canadian participant was recovered.
Final Canada.ca, ISED and BDC exact-name grant and program lane produced zero exact organization evidence.
Final CanadaBuys exact-name lane produced zero procurement, award or supplier evidence for Propellant Labs LLC.
Final Canadian entity, office, staff, partner and participant searches returned only global-access claims and unrelated rocket-propellant noise.

leads.doNotIngestReason: Propellant Labs is a real active California LLC operating a global remote accelerator, but exhaustive Canada-first recovery found no Canadian legal entity, office, staff member, Canada-specific program, named Canadian cohort participant, Canadian partner, procurement, grant or other durable operating nexus. Global availability, 25-plus-country reach and remote enrollment do not establish Canadian presence. The record should be excluded from the Canada-first organization corpus and re-opened only if a durable source establishes a Canadian entity, location, employee, funded program, partner or named participant.
leads.roleSpecificEvidence: Propellant Labs is a resolved active California LLC with a global remote accelerator offer, but exhaustive durable public-source recovery found no Canadian operating nexus.
